title: Custody collection - Phase 1.5 exit clauses, staged before opening
note: Four EXIT custodies, one per PHASE-1-5-X1..X4 clause staged in contracts/phase-1-5-opening.json. This file carries PROPOSED status only; it is not a live custody and it merges into contracts/custodies.json only when python scripts/sov_open_phase.py --apply runs. Each custody names the exact P15 commissioning predicates from SPEC.md it carries to closure.

custodies.initiative: Prove a fresh participant can resolve principal, isolated session, current campaign state, a bounded unit of work, capability, required authority, effect envelope, governance context, and Record projection from the artifact alone, and that accepted work's custody, closure, defeating condition, and cleanup obligations survive the session that carried it.

roots.serves: this clause is the P15-Q1 exit, stated verbatim in contracts/phase-1-5-opening.json
a fresh participant resolves principal, session, phase state, work, capability, authority, effect envelope, governance context, and Record projection without oral history
accepted work carries a durable address, custody or lease, closure condition, defeating condition, and cleanup obligations across sessions
principal identity, session continuity, grant authority, and interface binding refuse a cross-principal or cross-session mismatch rather than borrowing authority

closure.defeated_by: P15-Q1.1, P15-Q1.2, or P15-Q1.3 reported open by the instrument, or a fresh-participant fixture that discriminates only with private state or oral history

custodies.note: Staged only. No work lease exists under this custody until Phase 1.5 opens.

custodies.initiative: Prove consequential work reaches the append-preserving Record, every evaluative context names a RecordProjection with subject, recipient relation, cutoff, included evidence, declared omissions, and digest, WORK and PARTICIPANT_IN_WORK Findings stay separate and cited, and independent projections freeze before comparison without settling missing evidence by preference.

roots.serves: this clause is the P15-Q2 exit, stated verbatim in contracts/phase-1-5-opening.json
consequential operational history reaches the append-preserving Record and reconstructs without treating participant-private state as authoritative
every evaluative context uses a RecordProjection naming subject, recipient relation, cutoff, included evidence, declared omissions, and digest, and grants no authority
WORK and PARTICIPANT_IN_WORK Findings remain separate, name evaluator and scope, and cite evidence through the declared projection
independent evaluative projections freeze before their conclusions are shared, and comparison preserves frozen findings, citations, and dissent

closure.defeated_by: P15-Q2.1 through P15-Q2.4 reported open by the instrument, or a comparator that averages disagreement into a score instead of preserving dissent

custodies.note: Staged only. No work lease exists under this custody until Phase 1.5 opens.

custodies.initiative: Prove settlement follows current state plus required independent observation and retires declared leases, branches, worktrees, projections, and claims, and that another fresh participant can discover an accepted result, its standing, basis, receipts, and usable capability without oral history from the builder or a prior session.

roots.serves: this clause is the P15-Q3 exit, stated verbatim in contracts/phase-1-5-opening.json
settlement follows current state plus required independent observation, and closure retires temporary coordination inventory rather than leaving successful work unfinished
another fresh participant discovers an accepted result, its standing, basis, receipts, and usable capability without oral history

closure.defeated_by: P15-Q3.1 or P15-Q3.2 reported open by the instrument, or a fresh reader who cannot reach an accepted result's basis without asking the builder

custodies.note: Staged only. No work lease exists under this custody until Phase 1.5 opens.

custodies.initiative: Prove settled Records, scoped Findings, observations, and receipts can be cited into a later Proposal or candidate Definition that preserves its exact evidence addresses and gains no standing or authority merely from being generated, agreed with, or repeatedly demonstrated, expressed through primitives that do not depend on fixed Controller, Orchestrator, Worker, or Witness names.

roots.serves: this clause is the P15-Q4 exit, stated verbatim in contracts/phase-1-5-opening.json
settled Records, Findings, observations, and receipts may be cited into a later Proposal or candidate Definition while preserving exact evidence addresses
a generated, agreed, demonstrated, or repeatedly successful candidate Definition gains no standing or authority merely from that evidence
identity, session, authority, work, custody, Record projection, observation, finding, settlement, and discovery semantics do not depend on fixed institution names

closure.defeated_by: P15-Q4.1 through P15-Q4.3 reported open by the instrument, or a candidate Definition treated as binding policy merely because it was generated or demonstrated
